mapper.select: SELECT STOCK_DATE, MATERIAL_CODE, STOCK_NUM, AVAILABLE_STOCK, DATA_VERSION FROM T_MES_CD90_STOCK WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND STOCK_DATE IS NOT NULL AND MATERIAL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.MACHINE_CODE, t.BIG_ROLL_CODE, t.CLOTH_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_CD90_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT FACTORY_CODE, SCHEDULE_DATE, MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_CD90_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE 1 = 1
AND CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, #{queryParams.scheduleDate})
AND CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE, SCHEDULE_DATE, MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON t.FACTORY_CODE = latest.FACTORY_CODE AND t.SCHEDULE_DATE = latest.SCHEDULE_DATE AND t.MACHINE_CODE = latest.MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE 1 = 1
AND CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, #{queryParams.scheduleDate})
AND CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}
